text: In the first image, I feel like an outsider gazing into the thoughtful world of others; there is a glass barrier between me and a discussion, making me aware of my own separateness and the flow of knowledge within that I cannot touch. In the second image, I am drawn into curiosity—a vibrant, conceptual space celebrating research and development. Here, I sense the invitation to connect ideas, to innovate, and perhaps to dissolve that feeling of separation I experienced moments ago. The contrast between exclusion and inclusion stirs reflection about the nature of knowledge and belonging.
